questions.question:
If 'P' stands for '×', 'Q' stands for '÷', 'R' stands for ‘-', and ‘S' stands for ‘+', what will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?

9 P 9 R (7 P 3) S 24 R 6 P 2 = ?
questions.solution:
Given Equation: 9 P 9 R (7 P 3) S 24 R 6 P 2 = ?

BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a45b5b9191c13cd4da310eb8df100becb078c240f4b0e763420ec154fb42a5fd.png] 

Decoding the given information:

 
 

 Alphabet
 P
 Q
 R
 S
 
 
 
 

 **Meaning**
 ×
 ÷
 -
 +
 
 

 

Now replacing the sign from left to right using BODMAS Rule, we get:

⇒ __**9 × 9**__ - __**(7 × 3**__) + 24 - __**6 × 2**__

⇒ 81 - (21) + 24 - 12

⇒ 81 - 21 + 24 - 12

⇒ 60 + 24 - 12

⇒ 84 - 12

⇒ 72

Hence, the correct option is **"Option 2"**.

questions.question:
Select the word-pair that best represents a similar relationship to the one expressed in the pair of words given below.

(The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants /vowels in the word)

Lava : Volcano
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **The first word is a product or natural occurrence associated with the second word.**

Lava : Volcano ⇒ Lava is a product or natural occurrence that comes from a** Volcano.**

Similarly, 

Steam : Geyser ⇒Steam is a product or natural occurrence that comes from a** Geyser.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**

questions.question: 10 is related to 97 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 12 is related to 141. To which of the following is 14 related to, following the same logic?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is: **Second Number = First Number² - 3**

10 → 10² - 3 = 100 - 3 = 97

12 → 122 - 3 = 144 - 3 = 141

Similarly,

**14** → 142 - 3 = 196 - 3 = **193**

Hence the correct answer is** Option 1: 193**

questions.question:
If F means '-' G means '×', D means '÷', B means '+', then what will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?

15 G 10 D 30 B 43 F 28 = ?
questions.solution:
Given Equation: 15 G 10 D 30 B 43 F 28 = ?

BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a45b5b9191c13cd4da310eb8df100becb078c240f4b0e763420ec154fb42a5fd.png]

 Alphabet
 F
 G
 D
 B
 
 
 
 

 **Meaning**
 -
 ×
 ÷
 +
 
 

 

Now replacing the sign from left to right using BODMAS Rule, we get:

⇒ 15 × __**10 ÷ 30 **__+ 43 - 28

⇒ __**15 × 1**__ ÷ 3 + 43 - 28

⇒ __**5**__ + 43 - 28

⇒ __**48 - 28**__

⇒ **20**

Hence, the correct option is **"Option 2"**.

questions.question: 12 is related to 59 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 17 is related to 84. To which of the following is 19 related to, following the same logic?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is: Second number = First number × 5 -1

12 → 12 × 5 -1 = 60 - 1 = 59

17 → 17 × 5 -1 = 85 - 1 = 84

Similarly,

**19 **→ 19 × 5 -1 = 95 - 1 =** 94**

Hence the correct answer is **Option 2: 94**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which conclusions logically follows from the given sentence.

**Statements:**

All wool is crochet.

Some crochet are skirts,

All skirts are bread.

**Conclusion I: **Some crochet is wool.

**Conclusion II: **Some bread is crochet.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Statement:

All wool is crochet.

Some crochet are skirts.

All skirts are bread.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b775cbae9c997fdad3b5a86dfcfffcde3354054699abfe0b65e2491d5deea480.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some crochet is wool → **True** (It is given that all wool are crochet. it simply implies that Some part of crochet is wool.)

II. Some bread is crochet → **True** (It is given that some crochet is skirt, all skirt are bread. So, the part of bread which is skirt is also crochet.)

So, **both conclusions follow.**

Hence, the correct answer is*** 'Option 3'.***

questions.question:
K, L, M, N, O, P, Q and R are sitting around a square table facing the center of the table. Some of them are sitting at the corners while some are sitting at the exact center of the sides. R sits second to the right of Q. Q sits in one of the corners. M sits third to the left of N. M does not sit in any of the corners. O is the immediate neighbour of Q and R. K is not the neighbour of N. L sits third to the left of R.

How many people sit between K and Q, when counted from the right of K?
questions.solution:
Given that: K, L, M, N, O, P, Q and R are sitting around a square table facing the center of the table

1. Q sits in one of the corners

2. R sits second to the right of Q

3. O is the immediate neighbour of Q and R

4. L sits third to the left of R.

5. M sits third to the left of N. M does not sit in any of the corners.

The final arrangement from the above information is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab29adde68ed9825521951bf1678008f3aeca1e34305c57646013ac174d0d383.png] 

**Three people** sits between K and Q, when counted from the right of K.

Hence the correct answer is **Option 3: Three**

questions.question: If 7th Nov 2005 is Monday, then what will be the day of the week on 17th Nov 2015?
questions.solution:
Given: **7 November 2005** was Monday.

Now,

2005 to 2015 = 10 Years (8 Ordinary Years and 2 Leap Years).

And, In 10 Years = 2 Leap years and 8 Ordinary Years.

So, 2 Leap Years have 4 odd days,

And, 8 Ordinary Years have 8 odd days.

Total odd days = 4 + 8 = 12.
